stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, line \(\ell\) is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment with endpoints \((1, 2)\) and \((7, 6)\). At what value of \(x\) does line \(\ell\) cross the \(x\)-axis?
solution: The midpoint of the segment is \((4, 4)\), and the segment has slope \(\frac{6 - 2}{7 - 1} = \frac{2}{3}\).
verify:
x = symbols('x')
mid = (Rational(1 + 7, 2), Rational(2 + 6, 2))
ms = Rational(6 - 2, 7 - 1)
line = (-1/ms)*(x - mid[0]) + mid[1]
xi = solve(line, x)[0]
assert xi == Rational(20, 3)
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [xi]
